title: The last can
logline: After the dock's four cans: one more, alone, on the planks at dusk, and a hand setting it down from the page's edge. Whose hand: the page doesn't show. Five, then. The count corrected.

panels.composition: A single beer can being set down on dock planks at dusk by a hand entering from the page's edge, four pale rings on the planks beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a single beer can being set down on wooden dock planks at dusk by a hand entering from the page's edge, four pale rings on the planks beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
